title: Keep foreign investment screening focused on real risks and lower fees
action: Keep screening for genuine national security and fraud risks, but stop using application fees as a revenue source, index the agricultural land threshold, and reduce fees as a share of the investment.
why: Unnecessary delay and high fees deter foreign investment that brings capital, technology and know-how, particularly in agriculture.

evidence.source: 5-year Productivity Inquiry: Advancing Prosperity, Recommendations and Reform Directives
evidence.quote: its design should be cognisant of the potential chilling effects on investment and subsequent costs to productivity. Application fees for proposed foreign direct investment (FDI) should not be used as a tax base.

evidence.source: 5-year Productivity Inquiry: Advancing Prosperity, Recommendations and Reform Directives
evidence.quote: applying indexation to the threshold investment value, as is done with most commercial investments
